Clarification and stabilization of wine | In winemaking, clarification and stabilization are the processes by which insoluble matter suspended in the wine is removed before bottling.  This matter may include dead yeast cells (lees), bacteria, tartrates, proteins, pectins, various tannins and other phenolic compounds, as well as pieces of grape skin, pulp, stems and gums.
